baselineReproduction.method: Official `npm run build` in frontend/ (frontend/.env present, verified byte-identical SHA-256 to frontend/.env.docker before layering), byte totals over frontend/build/ - identical script and measures as the baseline.
baselineReproduction.result: Reproduced byte-for-byte before any change: 169 files / 4,975,690 B total (JS 2,516,529; CSS 98,378); entry entries/index-7sPx2DsL.js 57,764 B; every top chunk identical including hashes (Bookings 429,445; UserContext 269,898; useMobilePicker 192,742; vendor 178,287; Map 163,472; validator 126,673; schemas 115,132; router 101,323). Modules transformed 13,905 per the baseline record; frontend source was unchanged since that baseline.

candidates.after: The standalone whole-library validator chunk is eliminated. What remains is two dedicated lazy chunks: chunks/isEmail-Drt2vvsJ.js 8,408 B (isEmail + isFQDN/isIP deps) and chunks/isMobilePhone-BI0AoJx5.js 10,126 B, loaded only by the routes that validate.
candidates.attribution: Baseline attribution: the standalone validator chunk (126,673 B final; 234,387 rendered bytes over 128 modules) ships the whole validator library (index.js 11,526 rendered; isTaxID 27,843; isIdentityCard 11,536; isVAT 7,867; ...) while the frontend source uses exactly two functions: isEmail and isMobilePhone (models/CheckoutForm.ts, models/SettingsForm.ts, models/SignUpForm.ts, pages/Checkout.tsx).
candidates.detail: Each file now imports validator/es/lib/isEmail and/or validator/es/lib/isMobilePhone (the exact deep-import form queue #7 used in admin). SettingsForm passes the function directly as a zod refine callback, which the deep import preserves unchanged.

candidates.after: Post-change attribution: exactly one axios copy remains in the graph (frontend/node_modules/axios, 132,835 rendered bytes, all inside UserContext); the nested currency-converter copy is gone from every chunk. UserContext chunk 269,898 -> 237,065 B (-32,833 B, -12.2%).

incidents: Two wrapper invocations of the P0 script aborted before reporting: PowerShell converts the Jest process's stderr warnings into a NativeCommandError when its output is piped/redirected through a PowerShell pipeline (the script sets $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'). These were harness-redirection artifacts, not test failures; the gate was re-run with OS-level (cmd) redirection and passed in full: 7 suites / 36 tests, P0_EXIT=0.

The browser boot check's console showed AxiosError 'Network Error' entries from the automation Chrome profile. The identical error class was captured simultaneously from the OLD build running on a stale preview tab in the same profile, and the backend answers HTTP normally (host probes 200/404 as routed) - assessed as the profile's pre-existing API-reachability pattern, not a regression of this pass; the new UserContext chunk itself executed and issued the requests. The boot check ran under the profile's stored 'en' language for that origin and was left exactly as found.

One scp invocation early in the slice created a same-named directory on the laptop instead of a file (two sources, file destination); removed and re-sent as single-file copies before any use. No repo file was affected.

Not attempted.

The 2,037,251 B cover.mp4 static asset (F-PERF-FE-1) is content, not code: untouched by this slice. It is now 42.1% of total output bytes (was 40.9%) purely because the JS shrank around it.
